# Course Outline

## Summary
Modules in order, each opening to lessons (kind, length) and checks; dims unreleased modules when given `releasedIds`. Reads resolved cards; fetches nothing.

## Usage
`<CourseOutline @modules={{course.modules}} @releasedIds={{ids}} @onOpenModule={{fn}} />`

## Non-goals
No editing.
